$comment: Single source of truth for RoomHub. Backend: Ithaca.Application/Realtime/RoomEvents.cs (ADR-0025) (a test keeps them equal). Frontend: imported by src/shared/realtime/events.ts. See docs/realtime.md.

serverToClient.memberJoined: A member (user or guest) joined the room. Payload: { roomId, memberId }
serverToClient.memberLeft: A member left or was disconnected. Payload: { roomId, memberId }
serverToClient.memberReady: A member became ready (submitted their mood in a mood room). Payload: { roomId, memberId }
serverToClient.roomStarted: The host started the room: swiping begins. Payload: { roomId }
serverToClient.voteCast: Someone voted on a deck item. Payload: { roomId, deckItemId } (no vote values: results come from the API)
serverToClient.deckExtended: A new batch of deck items was added (group Just swipe). Payload: { roomId, fromPosition }
serverToClient.roomMatched: The room reached a match or best compromise. Payload: { roomId, tmdbId }
serverToClient.roomClosed: The host closed the room. Payload: { roomId }
